profile.name: Mar Roca Cugat
profile.title: Biomedical Sciences Researcher & AI Systems Developer
profile.status: BSc Candidate at Maastricht University & Flagship Hackathon Manager
profile.bio: Undergraduate researcher in Biomedical Sciences at Maastricht University passionate about cell biology, toxicology, genomics, and bio-image informatics. Active open-source developer building multi-agent research pipelines, automated laboratory analysis workflows, and embedded IoT tools. Experienced in academic governance and educational leadership within the Faculty of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (FHML).

items.title: Laboratory and Teaching Assistant
items.description: Assisting in practical laboratory sessions, guiding undergraduate students in biomedical techniques, and digitizing standardized experimental protocols for the Faculty of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences.

items.title: Head of Education
items.description: Representing biomedical sciences student interests, managing educational quality assurance initiatives, and collaborating with faculty administration on curriculum development.

items.title: Department Co-Manager & Software Developer
items.description: Co-managed the automation software development department and engineered open-source applications and high-availability Discord bots for community and developer workflows.

items.title: Technical Support Agent
items.description: Provided technical support, troubleshooting, and server deployment assistance for cloud and web hosting infrastructure clients.

items.title: Transwell Image Processing Scripts
items.description: Automated image processing scripts designed for quantifying and analyzing Transwell migration and invasion assays. Published with open-access archival via CERN/Zenodo (**DOI: 10.5281/ZENODO.20741673**).

items.title: Imaging Cardiac Arrhythmia in Zebrafish Genetic Disease Models
items.description: Co-authored standardized open-access laboratory protocol detailing high-resolution optical imaging of cardiac arrhythmia in zebrafish embryo disease models (**DOI: 10.17504/protocols.io.yxmvm1j75v3p/v1**).

items.title: Predator-Eater: Predatory Journal Detector
items.description: A cross-browser extension for Firefox and Google Chrome that automatically detects and alerts researchers when viewing potentially predatory academic journals.

items.title: TCGA-CDK-Analysis: Genomics Data Pipeline
items.description: Computational genomics and transcriptomics analysis investigating Cyclin-Dependent Kinases (CDKs) across The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA) datasets.

items.title: Staphylococcus Aureus Sampling Protocol
items.description: Peer-reviewed open-access methodology protocol covering sampling, isolation, and processing of Staphylococcus Aureus cultures (**DOI: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.81wgb6pk1lpk/v10**).

items.title: Autonomous Multi-Agent Literature Review System
items.description: Local LLM-driven multi-agent pipeline (CrewAI & lightweight local models) for conducting systematic scoping reviews, featuring automated RIS citation exports for Zotero, Obsidian knowledge vault generation, and an interactive Streamlit dashboard.

items.title: Bachelor of Science in Biomedical Sciences
items.organization: Maastricht University Faculty of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences
items.description: Focusing on toxicology, genomics, molecular biology, and biomedical data analysis. Active in educational improvement and open-access protocol standardization.

items.title: Radiation Protection Officer (TMS-VRS D)
items.organization: Maastricht University (FHML - Radiation Protection Unit Randwyck)
items.description: Specialized certification for handling dispersible radioactive substances level D safely within biomedical research laboratories.

items.title: Basic Course Quality Assurance for SEP-Members
items.description: Training on educational quality assurance, student evaluation panels, and providing structured feedback to improve higher education curricula.

items.title: International Baccalaureate (IB) Diploma Programme & Batxillerat
items.organization: INS Jaume Vicens Vives / International Baccalaureate
items.description: Rigorous bilingual secondary education program combining the IB Diploma and Spanish Batxillerat with a strong focus on experimental sciences and mathematics.

items.title: Q1 + 3rd Place in Subregionals (Catalan Biology Olympiad)
items.description: Achieved top placement in the regional phase of the Catalan Biology Olympiad, demonstrating advanced competency in molecular and organismal biology.

items.title: Top 50 - Regional Selection (Physics Olympiad)
items.description: Selected among the top 50 pre-regional participants in the Catalan Physics Olympiad.

items.title: Probability - First Place (DITMAE)
items.description: First place award in probability and mathematical modeling at the Dissabte Transfronterer de les Matemàtiques a l'Alt Empordà.

items.title: Categoria IDESCAT - First Place (Planter d'Estadística)
items.description: First place award for statistical research report on population health and sedentary behavior among youth.

items.title: First Aid Certificate
items.organization: Generalitat de Catalunya Servei Català de la Salut (SEM)
items.description: Certified emergency first aid training administered by the Medical Emergency Service of Catalonia.

items.title: Co-organizer
items.description: Co-organizing science communication initiatives, public engagement events, and educational workshops to bridge science and community.

items.title: Club Organizer
items.description: Facilitated coding workshops, hardware hacking sessions, and peer programming projects for youth developers.

items.title: Journalist & Public Relations
items.description: Managed public relations and authored school journal articles covering academic achievements, scientific developments, and student life.

items.title: Collection Curator (Geology and Natural History)
items.description: Curated, cataloged, and maintained geological and natural history specimens for educational exhibition and classroom instruction.

items.title: Volunteer in Lèxcit
items.description: Volunteered in reading and literacy support programs for children to improve linguistic comprehension and academic success.

items.title: Teaching Assistant for English
items.description: Assisted teachers in conducting interactive English language classes and conversational practice for primary students.

items.title: Open-Source Development & AI Tooling
items.description: Building developer utilities, browser extensions, and multi-agent AI pipelines with over 8,800 GitHub commits and active open-science contributions.

items.title: Bio-Image Informatics & Data Visualization
items.description: Exploring automated microscopy image processing, biological dataset pipelines, and interactive Streamlit dashboards for scientific research.

items.title: Multilingual Communication & Linguistics
items.description: Passionate about languages and cross-cultural communication. Fluent in Catalan, Spanish, and English (C2), with professional working proficiency in Dutch (B2) and foundational knowledge in French and Esperanto.
